entities.summary: Ryue Nishizawa is a Japanese architect based in Tokyo. A graduate of Yokohama National University, he established his own firm, Office of Ryue Nishizawa, in 1997. In 1995, he co-founded the firm SANAA with architect Kazuyo Sejima. In 2010, he became the youngest recipient ever of the Pritzker Prize, together with Sejima. Ryue Nishizawa was a architects & engineers from Yokohama (b. 1966-02-07, Yokohama). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
